tables.name: Leadership
tables.description: Village leadership can be formal, but can also be organic or unorganized.

results.name: No Leader
results.description: The village operates with no leadership, which could lead to unresolved disputes.

results.name: Natural Village Elder
results.description: The village recognizes a wise individual, and informally acknowledges them as an authority figure.

results.name: External Ruler
results.description: The village owes fealty to a ruler who is located outside the village itself.

results.name: Local Council
results.description: Prominent members of the community were chosen to lead the village collectively.

results.name: Single, Elected Leader
results.description: The locals democratically voted for their current leader.

results.name: Anarcho-Syndicalist Commune
results.description: The members of the village take turns as a sort of executive officer for the week.
